correctness.rationale: The two-mode theorem follows from exact first-step orthogonality, equality of the first Dai-Yuan and Fletcher-Reeves coefficients, A-conjugacy of the second direction, and an explicit 2 by 2 evaluation of the true and AOS model curvatures. The condition-number family and objective ratios were checked by the included symbolic artifact.

originality.rationale: The 2026 CG_AOS source leaves convergence and rate theory open, and no located source states the exact two-mode stepsize distortion, the sharp transient amplification, the kappa/4 explicit excursion family, or the sharp two-mode damping threshold. Ni and Liu (2024) is the closest identified prior work but describes a different Dai-Liao construction; its full text was not inspected and remains an explicit residual risk.

value.rationale: The result exposes a condition-number-scale overshoot mechanism in a newly proposed adaptive CG stepsize, showing that monotone or Wolfe-style convergence arguments cannot be assumed automatically. It also gives a sharp scalar repair threshold in the two-mode setting.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
